headline: Lexus Granito discloses annual general meeting voting results
hook: AGM voting results submitted to exchanges
summary: Lexus Granito (India) Limited has officially submitted the voting results of its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026, to the stock exchanges. This routine regulatory filing completes the mandatory post-AGM compliance process for the company. Indian retail investors holding shares in the micro-cap firm can review the outcome of shareholder resolutions through the exchange filings.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no direct impact on stock price.

headline: Lexus Granito (India) Limited submitted proceedings of its Annual General Meeting
summary: Lexus Granito (India) Limited has officially informed the stock exchanges regarding the proceedings of its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026. Such filings are standard regulatory compliance procedures following shareholder gatherings. Indian retail investors holding shares in the company should note this routine corporate update does not alter the company's financial standing.
why_it_matters: Routine procedural filing with no immediate impact on share value
